literal: Rare things having learned, those who are without fault even with, when examining, absence is rare indeed of ignorance.
translation: Even among those who have learned difficult subjects and are free from faults, when examined closely, a complete absence of ignorance is rare indeed.
modern: அரிய நூல்களைக் கற்று குற்றமற்றவர்களாக இருப்பவர்களிடத்திலும், ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்தால் அறியாமை சிறிதும் இல்லாமல் இருப்பது மிகவும் அரிது.
explanation: This couplet warns that no one is entirely perfect when choosing people for tasks. Even individuals who have mastered difficult subjects and appear completely faultless will have some minor flaws or areas of ignorance. The word 'வெளிறு' refers to ignorance or a blank spot in one's understanding. Therefore, a leader must carefully examine candidates and accept that a total absence of weakness is practically impossible to find.
